verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a SaaS compliance and registered-agent platform, so headless or CI-driven automation (for example, an API or CLI) is a fair question for a product of its type. The evidence pack contains only two robots.txt probes: one hit a Cloudflare challenge wall and the other found a legacy host that redirects into it. Neither says anything about headless, API or CI operation, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
